Granite Baron Veeramani Arrested in Chennai Child Abuse Case

Chennai police have arrested granite mining baron Veeramani and two associates in connection with a child abuse case. Months prior, police had filed a closure report in the same case. The News Minute reported that hours after their report, top police officials were placed on compulsory wait concerning the Veeramani case. India Today reported accessing a video central to the case.
